_note: No value is charged "where the amount of loans is not exceeding" the limit "in the aggregate" (D-118). Read as the amounts lent by one employer, added up, compared inclusively (D-118 C3a — a reading; the Rules define neither the amount nor the aggregate). TY 2026-27: "₹2,00,000" (r.15(5) Table IV Sl. 1 col. D (a), Gazette 271092, p.1546). TY 2025-26: "petty not exceeding in the aggregate twenty thousand rupees" (Rules 1962 r.3(7)(i) proviso, consolidated rule 3, p.3). Every regime.
